# `silk/test_runner`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The built-in test runner that `silk test` selects. It runs tests one at a time.

## Details
This module is a normal Silk application made from the public static test primitives. It finds
the tests in the compilation, applies the filters, runs each selected test in order, and writes
a receipt (see `silk.test_exchange`).

The host passes these options. Each takes one value:

| Option | Meaning | |---|---| | `--file` | Run only the tests in the file with exactly this
path | | `--filter` | Run only the tests whose `module::name` contains this text | |
`--silk-test-plan` | Path of the plan file. Required. | | `--silk-test-result` | Path of the
receipt file. Required. |

The runner checks the complete plan before any test body runs.

## Errors
The exit status is `0` if all selected tests pass, `1` if a test fails, and `2` for a usage
error, a plan that is not valid, or an I/O failure.

Import as `TestRunner` with `import silk.test_runner as TestRunner`.

Public declarations: 1.
